Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner redefined the task to compare “age at the time of the film’s release” rather than which director is older by birthdate. This misinterpretation would favor The Enchanted Desna (Solntseva ~63 in 1964) over Neal of the Navy (Bertram ~35 in 1915), contradicting the correct criterion (older person by birth year: Bertram 1880 vs. Solntseva 1901), and thus leads to the wrong film choice.
